tagline: Community Arch-based Linux distro (KDE, GNOME, Cinnamon, niri) great for Minecraft
description: PrismLinux is an open-source, community-driven Linux distribution based on Arch Linux and the pacman package manager. Its key feature is a single universal ISO installer that lets you choose your desktop environment or compositor during setup: KDE Plasma, GNOME, Cinnamon, or the scrollable tiling Wayland compositor niri. With up-to-date kernels, drivers, and sensible defaults, it is well-suited for gaming and running Minecraft smoothly on Linux.
features: Based on Arch Linux with the pacman package manager and fresh drivers
Single universal ISO offering KDE Plasma, GNOME, Cinnamon, or niri during installation
Practical out-of-the-box defaults for gaming, Minecraft, and daily workflows
